emphasis_points: Detail adjustable ergonomic controls: pneumatic gas lift height adjustment, tilt tension/lock, adjustable armrests (1D/2D/3D), and lumbar contouring.
Describe upholstery breathability and cushioning: high-density molded foam or breathable high-tensile mesh backrests.
Highlight 5-star base stability and smooth-rolling castors engineered for multi-surface flooring mobility.
avoid_list: Do not make medical claims or suggest clinical spine-curative properties.
Do not state maximum load weight capacities unless explicitly documented in manufacturer specifications.
Do not assume multi-directional 3D armrests or headrests are present on basic fixed-arm study chairs.
tone_notes: Ergonomic, active, and supportive, focusing on posture alignment, pressure dispersion, and long-session study endurance.
